sentences: Primitive-ordered pixel shading (10 PS, `src_pops_exiting_wave_id` wait loop, `s_sleep`, `MSG_ORDERED_PS_DONE`) becomes **fragment-shader interlock** (`PixelInterlockOrderedEXT`).
It begins at the end of the entry block and ends at shader exit: a longer critical section with the same ordering.
`src_pops_exiting_wave_id` reads 0, and **the runtime must put 0 (no collision, bit 31 clear) in the POPS collision SGPR**, so the hardware wait loop is skipped.
